name: ももいろインフラーＺ
overview:
‘Momoiro Infla Z’ (Momoiro Infla Zetto) is a variety programme broadcast on TOKYO MX on the first Sunday of every even-numbered month from 11:00 to 11:55, which teaches viewers in an entertaining way about the importance of essential infrastructure such as roads, railways, water and sewage systems, power grids, ports and dams.

This programme follows the four members of Momoiro Clover Z as they join ‘Infra-Z’—an organisation dedicated to training the ultimate ‘infrastructure warriors’ by teaching them about infrastructure such as roads, railways, water supply and sewerage systems, power grids, ports and dams—as rookie warriors. Under the guidance of instructor Satoshi Fujii, they learn about the importance of infrastructure in an entertaining way.
